visualCharacteristics.purpose: Highlighted key numbers with captions that count up on scroll
visualCharacteristics.layout: Centred row of large aubergine figures with captions, optionally beside a text column
notable: Count-up animation runs on a presentational overlay
stock variant shows the live XETRA share price with trend indicator
text variant uses a first heading row as a text column

contentPattern.structure: one row per figure: value cell as displayed, then caption cell; text variant adds a first one-cell row with heading and copy

usage: Use to highlight a few headline numbers or the current share price.
reuseGuidance: Fits short numeric values with brief captions; not for tables of data or long text.
